feature: Vanilla and Medieval Overhaul crop-period compatibility with AMJ Grains
scope: Named existing annual-field cultivated plants, growDays only; no new Mod or dependency

search.limitations: MO XML verified from provided 1.6 ZIP; Vanilla values from public mirror, not current game installation. VE/non-VE candidate contents not independently extracted; their public feature descriptions inspected. 1.7, other crop mods, loaded Def order and old saves not verified.
